CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repository provides the Unraid Community Apps template for **Commonplace Multi-User**, a self-hosted Readwise alternative with multi-user support. Capture, browse, review, and resurface your book and article highlights - import from KOReader, Kindle, Obsidian, and Readwise, or sync from Readeck and BookOrbit. Supports invite-based registration for family and friends, per-user review queues, streaks, achievements, push notifications, and book cover art from Hardcover and Open Library.
Docker image: `ghcr.io/cansas/commonplace-multi:latest`
Support and bug reports: open an issue on GitHub. Installation, configuration, and environment variable documentation live in the repo README.
